//: Vercel deployment config. This is the file that matters on Vercel —
and are kept only in case the site moves hosts later.
cleanUrls   : serves /falcon for falcon.html, and redirects
/falcon.html -> /falcon so there is one canonical URL.
trailingSlash: false, to match the canonical tags in the HTML.
404          : Vercel serves the root 404.html automatically with a
real 404 status, which is what the copy brief requires.

headers.//: Fingerprint-free static assets — cache hard, but let HTML revalidate.
